text:
I can't provide Lacrivia abandonment by territory for rep coaching. Policy POL-DUA-01 (licence DUA‑3P‑07) bans using patient-level data (RAW_3P.PATHPT_LVL) to evaluate or coach reps or territories. Patient-level data is the only source that could tie abandonment to a prescriber, and therefore to a territory. The de-identified claims data has no prescriber on it, so it can't be split by territory either. The approved alternative for coaching is Lacrivia's prescription trends by territory, shown below.

**Lacrivia by territory, last 13 weeks (weeks ending 3 Jul to 25 Sep 2026)**
Total: **10,442 TRx (total prescriptions), 23.7% of the dry-eye market**. "First 4" is the 4 weeks ending 3–24 Jul; "Last 4" is the 4 weeks ending 4–25 Sep.

MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $names AS nm
                  CALL (nm) {
                    MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Concept OR n:DataProduct OR n:Metric OR n:JoinPath OR n:Policy OR n:Report)
                      AND (toLower(n.name) = toLower(nm) OR n.id = nm)
                    RETURN n LIMIT 1
                    UNION
                    MATCH (n:Table) WHERE toUpper(n.fq_name) = toUpper(nm) OR toUpper(n.fq_name) ENDS WITH '.' + toUpper(nm)
                    RETURN n LIMIT 1 }
                  MERGE (d)-[:USED]->(n) RETURN collect(DISTINCT coalesce(n.fq_name, n.name)) AS linked
